# Implementation Plans

Store planning artifacts in this directory.

## Naming Convention
`YYYYMMDD-<short-task-slug>.plan.md`

## Required Sections
- Task summary
- Current state
- Desired state
- Repository findings
- Architecture impact
- Files to modify/create
- Configuration/infrastructure impact
- Implementation sequence
- Testing strategy
- Security considerations
- Risks and mitigations
- Verification checklist
- Handoff notes
